breakdown.description: The opposing horizontal tractions are reinterpreted as boundary-normal loads on the horizontal edges
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction, describing the loads as both 'horizontal tractions' (implying x-directed forces) and reinterpreting them as 'normal tractions on the horizontal top and bottom edges' (implying y-directed forces). The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect reinterpretation, keeping the loads as horizontal tractions (σ_xx). The agent incorrectly implemented the flawed reinterpretation, specifying normal (y-directed) tractions on the top and bottom boundaries, which contradicts the ground truth.
